rowChecks.title: P-Line TCB 8 Braid: US Teflon-Label Reference

methods.csv: Structured CSV parsing with strict bundled Python csv reader (newline='') and independent PowerShell Import-Csv. No line splitting or numeric coercion of IDs/SKUs. Exact 34-column schema and record widths checked.
methods.identity: Subtract actual native product-ID sets, retaining actual variant IDs. Match each new export row to the submitted CSV by exact unique SKU, and cross-check its identity against main ledger and signed handoff. Registry only validates, never supplies native IDs.
methods.preservation: Every parsed string field in all 1,019 baseline records compared by actual Product ID. No whitespace or HTML normalization for these existing records. All 34,646 fields equal, with original record order retained.
methods.newRecordComparison: All 34 fields compared against the exact submitted create-only CSV. Per-row submittedDifferences lists non-Description changes. Description differences are separately hashed and parsed.
methods.description: parse5 HTML parsing compares decoded text with whitespace normalization, ordered headings, every table cell/row, ordered links and their anchor text, and inline images including src/alt/width/height. Structural tag and attribute counts retained.
methods.images: Ordinary unauthenticated Node HTTP fetch of every native Hosted Image URL. Pillow EXIF-transposes, composites RGBA on white and compares displayed RGB pixels to approved local assets. Also compares 64x64 LANCZOS RGB images to all 14 candidates for unique matching.
methods.imageAcceptance: Decoded pixels exact, or aspect-ratio difference <0.002, own 64x64 RGB mean absolute error <2 (0-255 scale), unique closest expected source, next closest error greater than own +3. All14 also have exact original dimensions.

expectedNewRecordDifferences: Blank create-only product/variant IDs replaced by actual distinct server-assigned IDs.

Price '0' serialized as '0.00'; blank Sale Price serialized as '0.00'. All14 remain zero-price, On Sale No, Stock Unlimited, SERVICE, collection lines, category /line-guides, tag reelcalc-line-guide and no option values.
Hosted Image URLs rehosted from approved GitHub Pages URLs to unique native Squarespace CDN URLs. Asset basename preserved and decoded image content verified.
Four rows Visible No -> Yes, consistent with main's first four saved publications before this export.
Descriptions for those same four Public rows have native-editor wrapper and attribute changes. Ten Hidden rows remain byte-exact.

descriptionSummary.additionalAttributeChange: rel attributes appear on all anchors in the serialized copies; href and anchor text are unchanged.
descriptionSummary.retainedContent: All decoded text, ordered headings, full numeric tables, links and inline-image identity are unchanged under the stated semantic comparison. FAQ questions/answers and image caption text remain.
descriptionSummary.limitations: Not byte-identical HTML for four Public rows. Removed details/summary wrappers and styling hooks can change standalone fallback presentation/interactivity. This import check does not establish live page rendering or SEO correctness.

imageSummary.rawHashCaveat: All14 CDN file bytes differ from original files. Hashes also varied across the two successful fetches for some images. First-fetch transport hashes and separate decoded-check fetch hashes are retained as distinct observations, not asserted equal. Eleven re-encoded images are content matches under explicit pixel-distance criteria, not cryptographic equality.

gateValidation.note: Only imported-products.json changes. Existing registry provenance and original100 order are retained. No public/review/version/catalog promotion.

scope.laterVisibility: Main reports eight now Public. Later changes are deliberately not substituted into the four-Public native-export observation.
scope.nativeSeoNotVerifiedHere: The CSV schema contains no SEO title or SEO description columns. Main owns separate SEO/live observations.
scope.ledgerSnapshot: Main publication ledger hash pins the read snapshot. Main may continue updating that owned file; this report does not claim it remained unchanged afterward.
